EY-Parthenon - Turnaround and Restructuring Strategy - Manager / Senior - Hong Kong

Location:  Hong Kong
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date:  Oct 22, 2026

Job description

Requisition ID:  341041

The opportunity

 At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value - solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY's full spectrum of services, we've reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way. 
 

Your key responsibilities:

  • Assist in delivering key projects for our clients on a wide range of topics, covering Debt and Capital Advisory, including financial restructuring and sustainable finance, Recovery and Resolution work.
  • Assist in preparing and using financial models, including undertaking sensitivity and scenario analysis.
  • Assist in developing sustainable finance frameworks and supporting finance raising activities.
  • Assist in reviewing a company’s financial status, preparing forecast and prognosis of cash flow requirements.
  • Assist in business development activities including preparing presentations, go-to-market toolkits and attending pursuit meetings with clients.
     

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s or higher in accounting, finance, engineering, business, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • Professional qualification of CPA, CFA, PMP or other relevant qualification is preferred but not essential.
  • Knowledge of project financing, financial modelling and banking & capital markets.
  • Ability to perform commercial credit analysis and have basic knowledge of credit risk management concepts including policies and standards across commercials loan portfolios.
  • Ability to analyse companies, their capital structure and credit profile.
  • Able to work under high pressure and adapt to a dynamic working environment.
  • Excellent problem solving, facilitation and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong English and Mandarin written and verbal communication skills.
     

What working at EY organization offers

  • Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
     

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.
